title: UK universities to sponsor refugees under new asylum “safe routes” overhaul
summary_en: UK universities will be able to directly sponsor refugees to study in Britain under new government plans to expand “safe and legal routes” for those seeking protection.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: UK universities to sponsor refugees under new asylum “safe routes” overhaul

title: ETS acquires ACT in major US education assessment deal
summary_en: Global testing giant ETS has today acquired ACT, the organisation behind America's standardised college admissions test.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: ETS acquires ACT in major US education assessment deal

title: The students we lose after admission: why payment plans matter more than ever
summary_en: As volatile currencies and international exchange shortages continue to disrupt student journeys, Bimpe Femi-Oyewo says payment plans will not just expand access to education but will give institutions a competitive advantage.
author: Bimpe Femi-Oyewo
title_cn: The students we lose after admission: why payment plans matter more than ever

title: IIT Bombay eyes 2027 launch for first overseas sub-campus in the US
summary_en: The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay is set to establish its first academic presence in the US through a partnership with the State University of New York (SUNY) at Old Westbury, with the first certificate courses expected to launch in 2027.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: IIT Bombay eyes 2027 launch for first overseas sub-campus in the US

title: US terminates protection status for Haitians and Syrians
summary_en: The US Supreme Court has granted authorisation to the Trump Administration to end Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Haiti and Syria, putting hundreds of thousands of people at risk of deportation.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: US terminates protection status for Haitians and Syrians

title: Australia Bill proposes shift of international student allocation powers to ATEC
summary_en: Australia has introduced legislation that would shift the allocation of international student commencements to the Australian Tertiary Education Commission (ATEC), if passed.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Australia Bill proposes shift of international student allocation powers to ATEC

title: Everyone’s an expert in UKVI compliance now. Are the real experts getting a look‑in?
summary_en: The conversation about compliance is getting crowded, with the real expertise in danger of being drowned out. Mike Strong and Alex Lock consider the next steps for colleagues seeking to reclaim the conversation.
author: Alex Lock and Mike Strong
title_cn: Everyone’s an expert in UKVI compliance now. Are the real experts getting a look‑in?

title: France strengthens push to become leading destination for global researchers
summary_en: France is looking to strengthen its position as a destination for international researchers, even as competition for global scientific talent intensifies and doctoral enrolments begin to decline.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: France strengthens push to become leading destination for global researchers
